title: Driving, flying and landing in a Three.js Pittsburgh
author: No-Response3016
selftext:
I’m making Roadster City Drive with AI coding assistance. This clip is an actual drive, takeoff and landing in the browser.



The tricky part has been getting the visible roads and collision surfaces to agree, especially around bridges. Passing tests wasn’t enough: recordings of real drives exposed problems the scripted checks missed. Keeping each fix small and repeating the same route has been more useful than adding more effects.



It uses Three.js and OpenStreetMap data. AI also helped draft this post; the footage is gameplay, not generated video.



[https://roadstercitydrive.com/play/](https://roadstercitydrive.com/play/)

Google sign-in required. One free two-minute trial per account, then paid continuation. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
